description: Call this when you need the Solana memecoins traders are watching and a rug-check before you buy, swap, or recommend one. The list includes liquidity, market cap, pair age, 5m/1h/24h price and volume, buy/sell ratio, pump.fun bonding or graduation, and links to pump.fun, DexScreener, and Solscan. Each token has a one-line verdict, riskScore (0 clean to 100), riskLevel (low, medium, high, or unknown), and a risk breakdown with evidence and confidence: top-10 share, mint and freeze authority, LP lock percent, and sniper or bundle share of early supply. riskLevel is unknown when the holder, authority, LP, and sniper checks are all unread, and maxRisk leaves those tokens out. Holder percent falls back to the public RugCheck report at medium confidence when the public RPC cannot list the largest accounts. A successful RPC holder read is kept. Holder-concentration change over 5m/1h/24h is filled when this process has seen the mint before. A check that cannot be read says so, uses low confidence, and is not flagged. On-chain safety flags are plain-English sentences that fire when the top 10 holders own 50% or more, mint or freeze authority is still active, LP is unlocked, or snipers and bundled wallets took 20% or more of early supply. Market flags are short codes: low_liquidity, thin_volume, newly_launched, extreme_move, wash_suspect, paid_boost. Thin, new, and wash-like books are ranked down. The summary block counts tokens by risk level and names the top movers. limit is an integer from 1 to 25 and defaults to 15. minLiquidity is an optional USD floor. maxRisk is low, medium, high, or an integer from 0 to 100. Costs $0.005 USDC (5000 base units) via x402. The same price is charged for HTTP GET /token/trending. An unpaid HTTP call returns 402 even when the query is missing or invalid. A signed call with invalid arguments is rejected before settlement and is not charged. A successful result can set cached, stale, and cacheAgeMs. stale true means a previous result was served while a refresh runs or the upstream failed. You are charged only when the tool result is not an error.

limit.description: How many tokens to return. Integer from 1 to 25, or a numeric string. Default 15.

maxRisk.description: Optional maximum risk. low, medium, high, or an integer from 0 to 100.

minLiquidity.description: Optional minimum pool liquidity in USD. Tokens with unknown liquidity are left out.
